title: Chapter 267: Please Forgive Him!
html:
Chen Ge’s appearance in Doctor Skull-cracker’s costume terrified not only Wei Wu but the three medical students as well. None knew whom his words targeted, and with their lives seemingly at stake, none cared. Survival instinct sent them all running.

Yang Chen and Li Xue crowded beside Wei Wu as they fled toward Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy.

“Wait for me!” shouted Wang Dan, whom Wei Wu had knocked down. To his surprise, strength flooded back into his limbs as he scrambled upright.

“Why are you running too?” Wei Wu shouted at Yang Chen and Li Xue as they pulled ahead. Angry and anxious, he yelled, “Get out of my way!”

The bloody face screamed—the most violent reaction Wei Wu had ever seen from his monster. Blood vessels crawled from his back, wound down his arm, and reached toward Li Xue ahead of him. Feeling profoundly threatened, he knew he had to reunite with Kong Xiangming at any cost.

Chen Ge’s pupils narrowed. His Yin Yang Vision pierced the darkness, revealing the change in Wei Wu’s body. “I knew it—the Ghost Stories Society!”

Distance still separated them, while the blood vessels had nearly reached Li Xue. With no time to spare, Chen Ge scooped up the rolling mannequin head and hurled its now-shocked face at the back of Wei Wu’s skull.

BANG!

The mannequin head struck Wei Wu and sent him staggering, nearly to the floor, before rolling aside. The impact smashed the bloody face on his skull into a mangled pulp. The thunderous crack stunned the students. Hitting one person’s head with another head? Even a stunt performer would refuse such a scene.

“Still want to run?”

The blow slowed Wei Wu, allowing Chen Ge to close the distance rapidly. His blood face had suffered an injury before it could even use its power. Wei Wu dared not linger. “Move!”

Li Xue had no chance to evade and was thrown roughly aside. At the glass door, Yang Chen frowned in confusion.

“Wait. Isn’t he an actor? Why is he fleeing faster than us?” Possibilities raced through Yang Chen’s mind. “Is this still part of the experience? Some kind of internal drama?”

The sight of Li Xue being shoved aside angered him. “If so, this is unacceptable. How can they treat a visitor like that?”

Wei Wu charged savagely, but Yang Chen deliberately blocked the door. “If this is part of the performance, please stop. What you just did was—”

“Get lost!” Blood vessels seeped through Wei Wu’s skin and knitted across his face. The underground darkness concealed the change from Yang Chen, but not from Chen Ge’s Yin Yang Vision.

Chen Ge sprinted forward and, before Wei Wu could attack Yang Chen, swung the hammer into the man’s left arm.

Bone snapped with a clean crack, and all five visitors—including Wei Wu—seemed to turn to stone. Yang Chen stood closest and heard every detail. As a forensic science student, he could distinguish even the cartilage tearing between humerus and scapula. The words vanished from his mind. With one arm hanging uselessly, Wei Wu bit his lip bloody, shoved open the glass door with the other, and fled down the corridor.

“That path is a dead end. Let’s see where you run now!” Chen Ge lowered the hammer and turned to Yang Chen. “Are you all right?”

“Y-yes.” Yang Chen trembled. Without the wall supporting him, he would have collapsed.

“Good. I’m normally a gentle person, but that man isn’t an ordinary visitor. He’s different from you.” Chen Ge did his best to explain. He had resorted to violence only because Wei Wu threatened innocent people.

“I understand. That man is an employee here, isn’t he?” Yang Chen voiced his conclusion.

“An employee?” Chen Ge could not fathom the conclusion, but after a moment’s thought, he ‘honestly’ accepted it. “You already knew? The new actors still lack professionalism. He was far too rough, and I apologize on his behalf.”

The students stared at Chen Ge and his hammer in disbelief. How could anyone sound so casual after severely injuring another person?

“We don’t mind.” Inside, Yang Chen screamed, Shouldn’t you be more worried about the actor whose arm you just shattered?

“All right. When you get outside, speak to the uncle selling tickets. Your next visit will be eighty percent off.” Chen Ge called Gu Feiyu. “Xiao Gu, remove the barricade and come escort these visitors out.”

He had ordered Gu Feiyu to block the exit so the two Ghost Stories Society members could not escape. Now both were trapped inside Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy, a dead end, rendering the barricade unnecessary.

“Barricade the exit…” The students wiped away cold sweat. None planned to use that discount anytime soon.

“Wait here. An employee will collect you. I’ll go avenge you.” Chen Ge brandished the hammer. “As a service business, we must always put visitors first!”

Sensing Chen Ge’s murderous aura, Yang Chen hurried to object. “No! We’re perfectly fine. Please don’t avenge us!”

“Yes, that man wasn’t so bad.” Wang Dan approached but kept a safe distance. Inwardly, he muttered, At least he looked much friendlier than you…

“Stop making excuses for him. Anyone who makes a mistake must be punished.”

Chen Ge opened the glass door. Overcome by guilt, the students remained outside and shouted after him.

“Boss, we’re really fine!”

“Punishment is one thing, but you broke his arm!”

“We’ve already accepted your apology, so please forgive him!”

A faint stench lingered in the air. Hearing their pleas behind him, Chen Ge sighed. What kindhearted visitors. Jiujiang Medical University produces wonderful students—they’re defending the very people who harmed them.

He switched on the recorder and continued deeper into the corridor.
